import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Location {
        int r, c;
        Location(int _r, int _c) {
            r = _r;
            c = _c;
        }
    }

    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static int[] dc = {0, -1, 1, 0};
    static int sizeN, maxT;
    static char[][] maze = new char[12][12], mazeA = new char[12][12], mazeB = new char[12][12];
    static int[][] distA = new int[12][12], distB = new int[12][12];

    static void compute_distance_A(Location start) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distA[i], -1);
        }
        distA[start.r][start.c] = 0;
        Queue<Location> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(start);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Location p = q.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nr = p.r + dr[k];
                int nc = p.c + dc[k];
                if (maze[nr][nc] != '.') continue;
                if (distA[nr][nc] < 0) {
                    distA[nr][nc] = distA[p.r][p.c] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Location(nr, nc));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void compute_distance_B(Location start) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distB[i], -1);
        }
        distB[start.r][start.c] = 0;
        Queue<Location> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(start);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Location p = q.poll();
            if (distA[p.r][p.c] >= 0 && distB[p.r][p.c] >= distA[p.r][p.c]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nr = p.r + dr[k];
                int nc = p.c + dc[k];
                if (maze[nr][nc] != '.') continue;
                if (distB[nr][nc] < 0) {
                    if (distA[nr][nc] >= 0 && distA[nr][nc] < distB[p.r][p.c] + 1) continue;
                    distB[nr][nc] = distB[p.r][p.c] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Location(nr, nc));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class Network {
        int n;
        int[][] capacity, flow;
        int[] parent, level;

        Network(int size) {
            n = size;
            capacity = new int[n][n];
            flow = new int[n][n];
            parent = new int[n];
            level = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            capacity[u][v] += c;
        }

        int bfs(int s, int t, List<Integer> path) {
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == t) {
                    int minCap = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                        minCap = Math.min(minCap, capacity[parent[v]][v] - flow[parent[v]][v]);
                    }
                    path.clear();
                    for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                        path.add(v);
                    }
                    path.add(s);
                    Collections.reverse(path);
                    return minCap;
                }
                for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                    if (parent[v] < 0 && capacity[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0) {
                        parent[v] = u;
                        level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int total = 0;
            List<Integer> p = new ArrayList<>();
            int push;
            while ((push = bfs(s, t, p)) > 0) {
                for (int i = 0; i + 1 < p.size(); i++) {
                    int u = p.get(i);
                    int v = p.get(i + 1);
                    flow[u][v] += push;
                    flow[v][u] -= push;
                }
                total += push;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        sizeN = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        maxT = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(mazeA[i], '#');
            Arrays.fill(mazeB[i], '#');
            Arrays.fill(maze[i], '#');
        }

        for (int r = 1; r <= sizeN; r++) {
            String lineA = br.readLine();
            String lineB = br.readLine();
            for (int c = 1; c <= sizeN; c++) {
                mazeA[r][c] = lineA.charAt(c - 1);
                mazeB[r][c] = lineB.charAt(c - 1);
            }
        }

        List<Location> scientists = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Location> capsules = new ArrayList<>();
        Location z = new Location(0, 0);

        for (int r = 1; r <= sizeN; r++) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= sizeN; c++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(mazeA[r][c])) {
                    if (mazeA[r][c] > '0') {
                        scientists.add(new Location(r, c));
                    }
                    maze[r][c] = '.';
                } else if (mazeA[r][c] == 'Z') {
                    z = new Location(r, c);
                    maze[r][c] = '.';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(mazeB[r][c]) && mazeB[r][c] > '0') {
                    capsules.add(new Location(r, c));
                }
            }
        }

        compute_distance_A(z);
        int s = 0;
        int t = scientists.size() + capsules.size() + 1;
        Network net = new Network(t + 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < scientists.size(); i++) {
            int cap = mazeA[scientists.get(i).r][scientists.get(i).c] - '0';
            net.addEdge(s, i + 1, cap);
        }

        for (int j = 0; j < capsules.size(); j++) {
            int cap = mazeB[capsules.get(j).r][capsules.get(j).c] - '0';
            net.addEdge(scientists.size() + j + 1, t, cap);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < scientists.size(); i++) {
            compute_distance_B(scientists.get(i));
            for (int j = 0; j < capsules.size(); j++) {
                int distVal = distB[capsules.get(j).r][capsules.get(j).c];
                if (distVal >= 0 && distVal <= maxT) {
                    net.addEdge(i + 1, scientists.size() + j + 1, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                }
            }
        }

        int answer = net.maxFlow(s, t);
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
